loader.label: DeepSeek harness

start.why: DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: AGENTS.md is the first base candidate in each directory from the project root down to the session working directory
DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: CLAUDE.md is the second base candidate and loads beside AGENTS.md unless the two are identical after trimming
DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: AGENTS.local.md is a local overlay loaded after the base candidates in the same directory
DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: CLAUDE.local.md is the second local overlay, under the same per-directory trim dedup
DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: the user-global file is $DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md, defaulting to ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md
DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: the shared agents root is $DSH_AGENTS_HOME or ~/.agents, and a copy that matches the harness-home file collapses behind it

alsoReads.what: AGENTS.md below the session working directory
alsoReads.why: DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: a successful read, write or edit that reaches a deeper directory loads that directory's instruction file on the next request; shell navigation does not

loader.order: user-global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md, then ~/.agents/AGENTS.md, then every project candidate from the project root down to the working directory, broad to specific; within one directory, base files then local overlays

cap.why: DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: dsh-base sets maxBytes to 65536, and rendering drops whole broader files before truncating the most specific one

alsoCaps.why: DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: maxSourceBytes defaults to 1048576, and a larger source file is ignored rather than truncated into the chain

imports.why: DeepSeek harness agent-instructions docs: @path imports are not interpreted; a reference inside an instruction file is not an include

loader.nested: on touch — the baseline is the root-to-cwd chain; a deeper AGENTS.md loads after a successful read, write or edit in that directory, not because the shell changed directory
loader.skillsNote: the agent-instructions package does not document a project skill directory; shared agent configuration lives at ~/.agents, which is user scope and is not measured here
loader.hooksNote: DeepSeek harness hooks docs: the Claude Code and Codex bridges take an explicit configPath, and project-local hooks.json discovery is still marked TODO, so no repository path is loaded by default
loader.agentsNote: no file-based agents are documented for the DeepSeek harness in any first-party page checked on 2026-10-30

mcp.verified: DeepSeek harness MCP docs: a server is a profile plugin row (@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client), not a project file this tool can project

loader.verified: DeepSeek harness agent-instructions package (deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness packages/context/agent-instructions/README.md, read 2026-10-14) — the baseline loads ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md, ~/.agents/AGENTS.md, then AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md plus the local overlays from the project root down to the working directory; trimmed duplicates in one directory collapse; dsh-base caps the rendered baseline at 65536 bytes and ignores a source file over 1048576 bytes
loader.note: A drifted CLAUDE.md beside AGENTS.md is loaded in full. A symlink or a byte-identical copy is not. That is why this reader does not share Codex's one-file-per-directory rule.
